title: No index on contacts(peer_login) for ORDER BY and query_index
description: ContactStore::list() orders by peer_login and ContactStore::query_index() runs a correlated subquery 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacts c2 WHERE c2.peer_login < c1.peer_login'. Both require a full table scan of contacts without an index on peer_login. For a personal mailbox the contacts table stays small, so this is low severity today, but adding CREATE INDEX idx_contacts_peer_login ON contacts(peer_login) would make both queries index-range scans.
